Our Mission

Equity in perinatal health for every family

At Around-Birth Collective, we work to improve perinatal health in the Inland Empire and North San Diego County — providing direct services, increasing diversity in the perinatal workforce, and advocating for equitable access to quality care.

We believe that every birthing person deserves to be seen, supported, and empowered — regardless of background, identity, or zip code.

“Ensuring the period ‘Around-Birth’ is safe and supported for every family.”

Free prenatal vitamins, diapers, childbirth education

Founding Members

The collective
behind the care

Three experienced midwives and birth workers united by a shared vision of equitable perinatal health in Southern California.

01
Tristen Orosco
LM, CPM
Payómkawish midwife and ‘aqínnikat at Teméeku Midwifery. Dedicated to bringing midwifery care back to Indigenous communities as an act of radical sovereignty and cultural preservation.
02
LM
Leslie McFarlane
LCM, CBE, CLEC
Birth equity leader with 10+ years advancing justice for Black, Indigenous, and immigrant families through education, lactation support, and statewide policy work.
03
Yuli Smith
LM, CPM, IBCLC
Founder of Inland Empire Midwifery. Has secured over $10M in grant funding for perinatal programs and supported hundreds of families through the perinatal journey.
Our Impact

Making a difference where it matters most

The Inland Empire and North San Diego face some of California’s highest perinatal health disparities. We’re building a community-centered solution — bridging gaps in care for those who need it most.
